value.title: Forces of Nature
value.synopsis: Winter hits hard in cold Norway. Thord risks his life to keep the roads open while a winter storm strikes. Up in the north, Jo Roger and his son Ole Henrik are dealing with enormous amounts of snow.

value.title: Bad Day at the Gallows
value.synopsis: Thord has expanded his territory, and with new ground to cover comes new obstacles to cross. Up in the north, Jo Roger has handed over the responsibility for the company to his son, Ole Henrik. And when an egg truck is stuck in snow, Ole Henrik has a bad day at work, struggling with rescuing the 22 ton's truck.

value.title: Mountain Road Mania
value.synopsis: Ole and Roger mount a major rescue when a mail delivery truck plunges into a ditch. Meanwhile, recent changes mean big challenges for Thord.

value.title: Into the Night
value.synopsis: Daylight hours are short on Norway's most treacherous roads, where the darkness makes the tow truck rescuers' jobs all the more dangerous.

value.title: Fishy Business
value.synopsis: A truck loaded with fresh fish blocks a main traffic artery in northern Norway, so Jo Roger and his employee have no time to lose to get the truck free. Not only is there a risk of huge traffic jams forming, but 300,000 euros are at stake should the cargo not reach its recipient.

value.title: In the Family
value.synopsis: Being an ice road tow trucker, you have to work around the clock. The only way to make time for family life is to make the workplace like home, and a place for both family and friends.

value.title: River Deep
value.synopsis: In the far North of Norway, a brigade of road rescuers fight every day to keep the roads open and safe in winter. Damage control is a key factor. If they destroy anything during a rescue, they will have to pay the cost.

value.title: Mean Machine
value.synopsis: The ice road rescuers spring into action when a 30-tonne excavator upends itself in a deep ditch in the South of Norway.

value.title: Edge of Disaster
value.synopsis: Tow truck boss Thord and his team tackle the biggest rescue of their season when a 40-tonne snow plough crashes down a bank and on to a frozen lake.
